title: Exodus Escape Room

services.name: Escape Room Experiences
services.desc: In this spine tingling mystery, you are transported back to October 1984, where renowned author Jane Oliver is found dead in her own home under suspicious circumstances. Despite exhaustive efforts by detectives, it remains unsolved and has become a cold case. You are on the verge of unlocking the legendary elixir that turns metal into gold, but a single mistake threatens it all. Poison lingers in the air, deadly plants surround you, and in a moment, it all goes wrong. With time ticking, every decision becomes a dangerous gamble. Vendetta 15 is Villains Vendetta with a totally rad 80’s reskin! Same epic challenges you love, plus one brand new one, a fresh new look and heroes and villains

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We can be found in Anaheim Hills Orange County, Rancho Cucamonga, and Tustin. When you’re done escaping with Exodus, you’re driving distance from downtown LA or the San Bernardino Mountains.
